title: A Bucket Brigade Analysis of Meme Transport in Group Chats
abstract: We analyze how memes are relayed across overloaded group chats and argue that forwarding latency predicts conversational collapse.
body:
Introduction
The manuscript studies forwarding chains in group chats and proposes that meme transport behaves like an overloaded bucket brigade.

Method
The paper manually annotates forwarding events and classifies response delays.

Results
It reports several plausible patterns but leaves the evidence thin.

Discussion
The idea is interesting but underspecified.

Conclusion
The framing is memorable.

Limitations
The sample is small and manually labeled.
